title: Classified paper comparing human and ET psychic ability that disappeared

tellings.quote: I was tasked to do a paper that as soon as I turned it in, it disappeared.

plain: In the 1980s, says the former Army sergeant Lyn Buchanan, he was ordered to write a classified paper comparing the psychic abilities of humans with those of extraterrestrials, and "as soon as I turned it in, it disappeared". Buchanan served in the Army's remote viewing unit, a group trained to describe distant places and things by the mind alone, and tells Michels this as something that happened to him. If true, the military took alien psychic ability seriously enough to study it and then hid the result.
